notes.title: Patch V1.02
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.02[/h1]
Hello all you EPIC Plasma Gamers! We hope you're enjoying throw bro!  If not then I don't know what to tell you but here we have a brand new patch!  Here's the rundown:

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added Tutorial animations so people know how to jump!
[*] Boom Effect goes big boom!! WOAH!
[*] Green golem doesn’t break it down when you’re above him
[*] Umbrella kinda makes more sense now
[/olist]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some uncomfortable level design
[*] Game runs faster like brrrrr
[*] Some spelling (thanks discord)
[*] Crab tank no longer kicks you out of bounds (probably)
[/list]

notes.title: Throw Bro Full Release!
notes.content:
Throw Bro throws the competition!
The games finally here in it's full release form and we couldn't be more excited! It's been a wild ride developing this game with all the Epic Plasma Gamers on YouTube and Discord! Thank you to everyone who's supported us and Throw Bro and we hope you're just as excited as we are to play it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030864/362cf9fcf0680fef6cc3135dcb9c54cec0da6798.gif[/img]
What are you waiting for? Get throwing!!
